name: Naafiri
notes: Packmates (We Are More's summons, The Call of the Pack's extra summons, and Hounds' Pursuit's per-Packmate collision hits) are other units: per the fight rules only the stationary dummy and Naafiri exist, so all Packmate damage and Packmate-count mechanics are omitted entirely; only Naafiri's own attacks and ability damage are modeled.

Opening and loop: cast The Call of the Pack (W) first for its +20% total AD hunt buff, then Hounds' Pursuit (R) once its 0.75s channel can start (R never recasts since no takedown occurs on a dummy), then Eviscerate (E) and Darkin Daggers (Q) on cooldown; whichever of W/E/R/Q is off cooldown and Naafiri is free to act on goes next, so the exact interleave shifts with the item build's cooldown reduction.

Darkin Daggers (Q) is always recast at the earliest opportunity (0.75s after the initial cast, from the bin's NaafiriQ.RecastLockout) rather than the wiki tooltip's 0.5s, since the datamined value is treated as authoritative; the recast converts the still-bleeding target's undelivered bleed damage plus a missing-health-scaled bonus into one burst, computed from the target's missing health before that bleed damage lands, and starts Q's cooldown ('post-effect').

The Call of the Pack's hunt buff (+20% total AD to Naafiri, used on both her attacks and Q/E/R) is treated as active from the end of its 0.75s cast (when the tooltip's 'Effect at cast time end' triggers) until 5 seconds after the cast started (the hunt's stated duration, which begins at the start of the cast).

Hounds' Pursuit's bin-only NaafiriW#ArmorShred/ShredDuration fields are excluded: the current wiki tooltip never describes an armor shred on this ability, so they are treated as legacy/unused data rather than a live effect.
No ability damage here is treated as able to critically strike (none of the sources describe Q/E/R as crit-capable).
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing here binds inside a 15 s fight at level 16 given the assumed cast cadence.
